calc_iou: compute the IoU of two axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes given their center and lengths
single_scene_precision_recall: compute true positives, false positives, and false negatives for predicted bounding boxes against ground truth
multi_scene_precision_recall: compute precision and recall across multiple scenes with optional label and prediction masks
precision_recall: calculate precision and recall metrics from true positive, false positive, and false negative counts
test_metric_util: run the built-in IoU and precision recall unit tests for the metric utility functions
